notes: Cortex 2.1.1: agents find much more of what you saved. Fixed a search bug where AI agents only ever searched your 10 most recently changed notes; cortex_start can take a goal and hands back the memory passages that matter; search results and the Claude Code 'Related memories' hint show the passage that actually answers (not a snippet cut mid-word); Fetcher's free check tells agents when your notes already cover a topic, so they read instead of paying for research; the agent journal and activity log no longer store secrets such as your phone pairing token. Measured with the Train AI benchmark: 2.4x more passes per dollar than 2.1.0.
